body:
Maintainer request from #1572 ("which formats convert to a solid our STEP importer loads whole, and which lose faces or come out as surfaces only. Offer only the formats that pass.").

Depends on #1873.

## Goal
Qualify candidate native CAD and IGES formats with clean-room real files against `cadmpeg` and CamCraft's STEP importer, and enable only formats that produce verified closed solids.

## Scope
- Install `cadmpeg` (`>= 0.6.12`), inspect its `FORMATS.md` matrix and `cadmpeg formats --json` output, and confirm clean-room test fixture provenance (files created by contributors or permissively licensed public files; no proprietary HSMWorks files).
- Test sample parts across candidate formats: IGES (`.iges`, `.igs`, `L9`), FreeCAD (`.FCStd`, `L5`), Fusion (`.f3d`, `.f3z`, `L5`), SolidWorks (`.sldprt`, `L3`), Inventor (`.ipt`, `.iam`, `L3`), CATIA V5 (`.CATPart`, `L3`), ACIS (`.sat`, `.sab`, `L3`), and Rhino (`.3dm`, `L2`).
- Keep `L1` container-only formats (Siemens NX and Creo `.prt`) disabled unless `cadmpeg` reaches B-rep maturity.
- Record for each format: `cadmpeg check --json` exit status and warnings, unit preservation in exported STEP, `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` (`step_closed::closed_shells`) pass vs `mesh_open.rs` open-shell refusal, and bounding-box dimensions against known source geometry.
- Populate the shared qualified-extension allowlist in `camcraft-app` with passing formats only, and keep explicit named refusals for excluded, `L1`, or multi-body unsupported formats.
- Commit clean-room integration fixtures (where licensing and size allow) and record the matrix results in docs and tests.

## Done means
Every candidate format has a recorded real-file test result; verified solid-producing formats are enabled in `camcraft-app`'s shared extension table, and failing or `L1` formats stay explicitly refused by name.

Part of #1572
